g.text: RIGOR-RS: How the Autonomous AI Researcher Works (Plain English)
TikTok TechJam 2026 Track #2 — Autonomous Recommender Research on KuaiRand-Pure
A self-driving AI lab with all Design Decisions [DD-1 to DD-9] from Design-Decision.md clearly mapped and labeled.
🎯 Goal: Rank User Videos
Put each user's favorites first
🏷️ Target: long_view
Predict if user watches > 3s
📊 Score: GAUC + nDCG@5
High ranking quality + top-5 focus
⚡ Target Baseline: 0.5946
Official standard to beat
🗄️ LAYER 1: DATA & SCIENTIFIC MEMORY (The Study Material, Practice Test, and Lab Notebook)
📚 1. Training History (The Textbook)
• 1.14 Million Past Video Interactions (14 Days: April 8–21)
Shows what videos users clicked, liked, followed, and watched for a long time.
⚡ [DD-1] Train-Only Co-Occurrence Store (Design-Decision §1):
Pre-computes which videos users often watch together to spot natural video clusters.
🔒 Strict Rule: All model feature learning happens ONLY on this training data.
No future data or test answers are ever peeked at.
📝 2. Validation Set (The Practice Test)
• 7 Days of Real Interactions (April 22–28)
Used after every experiment to see if the new model actually improved.
🎯 The True Source of Truth:
Evaluated strictly using the official competition scoring script (evaluate.py).
✅ Decision Rule: Only models that beat previous validation scores are kept.
If a model fails on the practice test, the AI rejects it and tries another idea.
📖 3. Lab Notebook & Rollback [DD-6]
• SQLite Database: Never Deletes Past History
Records every hypothesis, code diff, metric receipt, and failure cause.
💾 Checkpoint Storage:
Saves the best working model weights and safe fallback checkpoints.
⚡ [DD-6] Transactional Rollback: Rewind cleanly to stable_fallback parent.
Also tracks total AI tokens, GPU hours, and guarantees 0 human interventions.
🔒 4. Sealed Test Set (The Locked Final Exam)
• 23,875 Test Users (10 Days: April 29–May 8)
The official competition evaluation dataset.
❌ ZERO Access During Development:
The AI is never allowed to inspect, train on, or tune against test answers.
🛑 One-Time Execution: Used exactly 1 time at the end to make final predictions.
Ensures 100% academic and competition integrity with zero data leakage.
🎲 5. Unbiased Random Data [OPTIONAL]
• 1.18 Million Completely Random Exposures
Videos shown to users at random without recommendation algorithm bias.
🔬 Exposure Bias Reality Check:
Verifies that our model actually understands user taste, not just popularity.
✨ Advanced Counterfactual Verification:
Optional secondary safety check to ensure robust real-world ranking.
🧠 LAYER 2: THE AI RESEARCH TEAM & KNOWLEDGE GATEWAY (The Brains of the Operation)
🌐 Research Knowledge Gateway (How the AI Searches Real Science & Code)
📖 Academic Paper Search
• Searches OpenAlex & arXiv
• Finds relevant RecSys papers
No blind guessing: Grounded in science
💻 GitHub Search [DD-8]
• ⚡ [DD-8] Read-only GitHub API
• Rate limits: 30 search/m, 10 code/m
Pinned SHA & license verification
📚 Top-25 Seed Papers [DD-3]
• ⚡ [DD-3] Curated offline seed corpus
• Non-exclusive (avoids closed bias)
Hybrid search: sqlite-vec + BM25
🔗 Paper-to-Code [DD-9 / OPT]
• ⚡ [DD-9] Direct repo shortcut
• Optional legacy fallback adapter
OpenAlex is primary discovery
🛡️ AI Security & License Gate
• Strips malicious prompt injections from text
• Filters out retracted or fake papers
• Rejects restricted / non-commercial licenses
Ensures safety: Untrusted web text cannot hack the agent
🗃️ Vector Knowledge Base [DD-3]
• Stores paper summaries, code, and citations
• ⚡ [DD-3] Hybrid search: exact BM25 + embeddings
• Fast lookup for NDCG, GAUC, negative sampling
Provides evidence cards before writing code
⚡ Smart Cache & Caps [DD-2]
⚡ [DD-2] Triple Protection Against Waste:
1. Canonical key cache: provider + query + filters
2. Separate caps for API calls, docs & LLM tokens
3. Prevents cross-query contamination & runaway bills
🔧 Safe Read-Only Tools (What the AI Agents Call to Learn):
search_evidence() & get_paper()
• Finds papers on specific recommendation ideas
• Pulls clean paper abstracts & key findings
Result: Clear scientific reasoning for changes
search_code() & get_code()
• Finds tested PyTorch architecture modules
• Inspects layer shapes and loss formulas
Result: Fast implementation of proven models
get_research_card() & expand_citations()
• Summarizes why a specific technique works
• Traces citation graph to find parent innovations
Result: Evidence card attached to each experiment
🧑‍🔬 Agent 1: The Research Scientist (The Strategic Planner)
INPUTS (What it looks at):
• Data stats • Past experiment outcomes • Evidence cards • Compute budget
HIGH-LEVERAGE RESEARCH PRIORITIES (Focus on Real Gains):
1. Ranking Loss: Pairwise BPR / Listwise loss (directly teaches ranking order)
2. Sequence Models: DIN / SASRec (learns what user watched in sequence)
3. Multi-Task Learning: MMoE / PLE (uses clicks, likes, watch time together)
4. Watch-Time Duration: Survival loss for play_time_ms (censored duration)
❌ Ignores Dead Ends: Skips static user metadata and blind capacity scaling.
Queries scientific literature before making any hypothesis.
OUTPUT: Pre-Registered Research Contract (No Hindsight Bias):
• 1 clear hypothesis + expected improvement on GAUC and nDCG@5
• Pre-declared rules for what to do based on results:
- If it beats baseline by > 0.002 → Keep and make it new best model
- If GAUC goes up but nDCG drops → Investigate multi-task balance
- If model overfits → Add regularization / dropout
- If score drops → Reject change and try another research branch
Hands the approved research plan to the Coder Agent.
👨‍💻 Agent 2: The Code Engineer (The Builder & Fixer)
INPUTS:
• Approved research plan • Reference PyTorch code • Base model codebase
RESPONSIBILITIES & SECURITY GUARDS:
• Writes minimal, surgical PyTorch code edits in an isolated Git branch
• Writes unit tests to verify tensor shapes and device compatibility
🔒 Immutability Sentinels (Hard Constraints):
❌ Cannot touch evaluate.py (The referee is locked and immutable)
❌ Cannot alter dataset split dates or label definitions
🔧 Local Bug Fixing: Automatically fixes syntax, dimension, or device typos.
OUTPUT: Isolated Code Patch & Verification Tests
• Clean atomic code patch (diff.patch)
• Pinned configuration file with sha256 checksum
Isolated Worktree Execution:
- Tested in an isolated temporary Git worktree
- Main repo stays 100% clean and uncorrupted
Semantic Fix Target: If training fails, Coder fixes bugs autonomously.
Sends verified patch to the Execution Engine.
⚙️ LAYER 3: FAST & SAFE EXECUTION ENGINE (The Muscle — Safe Code, Fast Filters, GPU Trainer & Referee)
📊 1. Data Profiler (The Inspector)
Scans training data to find key patterns:
• Counts interactions & candidate video list lengths
User Behavior Distribution:
- 27.1% users watched 0 videos long (fixed 0 score)
- 9.2% users watched all videos long (fixed 1 score)
- 63.7% active users (where GAUC is won or lost)
• Checks user history lengths (ready for sequence models)
• Analyzes watch time censoring & unseen video rates
OUTPUT: Compact Diagnostic Digest
• Sends summary stats to Scientist (0 raw data in prompt)
🛡️ 2. Data Leakage Sentinel [DD-7]
⚡ [DD-7] Typed Contracts (Design-Decision §7):
• Verifies column types, IDs, and row counts
• Ensures row_id numbers are continuous from 0
• Confirms no validation data leaked into training
• Checks that no NaN or infinite values exist
• Verifies file checksums (sha256)
⚠️ Safety First Policy:
• If any safety boundary is violated, fail-closed immediately
• Log error and ask Coder to fix without wasting GPU
Guarantees zero accidental data contamination.
🚦 3. Safety Funnel & Proxy Gate [DD-4, DD-5]
⚡ [DD-5] 4 Absolute Validation Gates (Not Bottom Ranking):
Tier 1: Code & Schema Check (Takes 0 GPU seconds)
• Checks syntax, imports, and ensures evaluate.py was not edited
Pass → Go to Tier 2 | Fail → Send back to Coder
Tier 2: 100-Batch Smoke Test (Takes 5 seconds)
• Tests tensor forward & backward passes; checks loss is finite
Pass → Go to Tier 3 | Fail → Fast recovery doctor
Tier 3: Quick Subsample Test [DD-4 Filter-Only]
• Trains on small sample to catch memory blowups or flat loss
⚡ [DD-4] Strict Filter-Only Rules (Design-Decision §4):
- May REJECT bad runs (crashes, OOMs, severe drops)
- NEVER decides final winner (only full training counts)
Tier 4: Full Training & Validation Promotion
• Cleared for full 1.14M interaction training run
• Evaluated on the 7-day validation practice test
WHY THIS MATTERS (Engineering Efficiency):
• Catches broken code and crashes in seconds, not hours
• Saves > 80% of GPU compute budget on non-viable code
• Absolute thresholds prevent throwing away promising ideas
Every check is logged in SQLite for full auditability.
🚀 4. GPU Training Engine (The Muscle)
INPUTS (What it trains on):
• Verified code patch + Full 1.14M Training Split + Frozen Preprocessing
TRAINING PROTOCOL & MONITORING:
• Pinned random seeds for 100% reproducible results
• Atomic model checkpoint writes with sha256 hashes
• Live telemetry: GPU RAM, training loss, learning rate
Multi-Task Signal Tracking:
• Monitors auxiliary tasks (clicks, likes, watch time)
• Measures if auxiliary signals help or hurt the long_view ranking
Sanity Invariant Checks:
• Shuffling labels drops scores to chance (~0.475) as expected
OUTPUTS:
• Checkpoint weights (checkpoint.pt) → Saved in Ledger
• Validation Predictions (scores array) → Sent to Evaluator
Crash Doctor Interception:
• If CUDA runs out of memory, caught safely without crashing
PERFORMANCE & SPEED:
• CPU baseline runs in ~40 seconds
• GPU throughput: > 50,000 interactions per second
100% reproducible anywhere from saved seeds & configs.
🚑 5. Crash Doctor & Rollback [DD-6]
Catches: Out of Memory (OOM), NaN loss, Timeouts
⚡ 3-Step Automatic Memory Fix Ladder:
1. Cut batch size in half (2048 → 1024 → 512)
2. Turn on Mixed Precision (fp16 / bf16 to halve VRAM)
3. Enable Gradient Accumulation & Checkpointing
🔄 ⚡ [DD-6] Safe Rollback (Never deletes past errors):
• Saves crash stacktrace in ledger receipt
• Resets Git branch to stable_fallback parent
• Prunes dead branch from research roadmap
Bug Escalation: If parameter tuning fails, hands bug to Coder.
0 human interventions needed to recover from crashes.
⚖️ 6. Official Referee (evaluate.py)
OFFICIAL COMPETITION SCORING (LOCKED):
evaluate(user_ids, labels, scores)
HOW THE SCORE IS CALCULATED:
• GAUC: Group AUC per user (evaluates 63.7% active users)
• nDCG@5: Measures quality of top 5 slots for all users
• Primary Score = (GAUC + nDCG@5) / 2
(Oracle Ceiling = 0.8645 because 27.1% users have 0 positive videos)
OUTPUT: Signed Metric Receipt with Cryptographic Hash
Verified before every single experiment to prevent cheating.
🎯 7. Convergence Watchdog (The Decision Hub)
INPUTS:
• Signed Metric Receipt (GAUC, nDCG@5) • Tokens & GPU-hours spent
WHEN TO KEEP EXPERIMENTING VS STOP:
• Baseline FM Score to beat: 0.5946 (std σ = 0.0008)
⚡ Stop Condition: Plateau for 3 Rounds or Out of Budget
• If improvement is less than ε = 0.002 for 3 consecutive rounds
OR GPU / token budget is reached → Stop loop
Freezes validation-best model as the final champion
Guarantees we submit the converged best model, not random noise.
AUTOMATED ROUTING DECISION:
Route A: Continue Loop (If still improving)
Sends results to Scientist to plan next improvement (Step 9)
Route B: Finalize & Export (Converged / Done)
Locks code and triggers the 1-way Finalizer Engine (Step 10)
Zero human intervention required to decide when to stop.
LEDGER UPDATE & RESOURCE METRIC ACCOUNTING:
• Appends run record, diff, metric receipt to SQLite
• Increments token & GPU counters
Generates machine-readable results.json & report.md automatically.
🏆 LAYER 4: FINALIZATION & PACKAGING (The Winning Submission — One-Way Gate)
📦 Finalizer Engine (Takes the Final Exam Once)
INPUTS: Confirmed Best Model Checkpoint + Sealed Test Features
• Runs strictly after research has converged (improvement < 0.002 for 3 rounds)
• Replays clean environment and applies frozen train-fitted transformations
• Generates final predictions for all 23,875 test users (04/29–05/08)
🔒 Sealed Test Rule: Exactly 1 forward pass; never peeks at test ground-truth labels
Submission Validation: python3 submit.py --check --split test submission.csv
Verifies: row_id integrity, user/video alignment, no NaN/Infs, exact row count
🏆 FINAL SUBMISSION PACKAGE (Audit-Ready & Verified)
📄 predictions.csv (Exact Submission Format):
row_id,user_id,video_id,score (0-indexed deterministic sequence)
• Cryptographic Manifest: Dataset sha256, git commit, config hash, environment receipt
• Complete SQLite Run Ledger: All experiment contracts, metrics, diff patches & recovery events
• Resource Accounting: Cumulative LLM tokens, GPU hours, wall-clock seconds, manual_interventions=0
✅ Clean-Machine Reproducibility: Fully executable on clean machine without interventions
Submitted once to organizer terminal evaluation; final artifact selection is irreversible
🗺️ THE 11-STEP AUTONOMOUS RESEARCH CYCLE & DESIGN DECISIONS MAPPING
LLM Reasoning Layer
Research Knowledge MCP [OPTIONAL]
Deterministic Kernel & Execution
Multi-Tier Pruner & Proxy Gate [OPTIONAL]
Security Boundary / Sealed Test / Rollback
Final Submission Artifact
[OPTIONAL] Module
⚡ DESIGN DECISIONS MAPPING INDEX (from Design-Decision.md):
[DD-1] Offline Co-Occurrence (Layer 1.2) • [DD-2] Query-Hash Cache & Caps (Layer 2A.2) • [DD-3] Top-25 Local Vector Store (Layer 2A.1 & 2A.2)
[DD-4] Filter-Only Proxy (Layer 3.3) • [DD-5] Multi-Tier Pruning (Layer 3.3) • [DD-6] Transactional Rollback (Layer 3.5 & 1.3) • [DD-7] Phase-Boundary Checks (Layer 3.2)
[DD-8] Local GitHub MCP Adapter (Layer 2A.1)
[DD-9] Papers with Code Adapter (Layer 2A.1)
Step 1: Inspect Training Data
Profiler scans 1.14M interactions → extracts user variance & sequence lengths for Scientist.
Step 2: Search Science & Code [OPTIONAL - DD-8, DD-3]
Scientist queries research papers (arXiv) & reference code (GitHub) via safe MCP gateway.
Step 3: Pre-Register Plan
Scientist writes 1 clear hypothesis + pre-declared decisions (no hindsight bias) for the Coder.
Step 4: Write Code Patch & Tests
Coder creates minimal PyTorch patch in isolated Git branch; referee (evaluate.py) is locked.
Step 5: Run Fast Safety Funnel [DD-4, DD-5]
Tier 1 Static → Tier 2 100-Batch Smoke → Tier 3 Subsample (catches crashes in seconds).
Step 6: Full GPU Model Training
Full training run on 1.14M rows with seed pinning, atomic checkpointing & live telemetry.
Step 7: Official Validation Practice Test
Model is scored strictly by evaluate.py on 7-day validation split (GAUC & nDCG@5).
Step 8: Save Receipt & Checkpoints
Signed receipt sent to Watchdog; Run Ledger updated; checkpoint saved; tokens counted.
Step 9 / Step 10 & 11: Next Loop or Finalize
Step 9 (If improving): Loop back to Scientist | Step 10 & 11 (Plateau / Done): Run test set & export.
